note: Liquid mercury beside water (a look at how the renderer draws a metal): 100 g of mercury (7.4 mL) in a 50 mL beaker, beside a 50 mL beaker of water and one of copper sulfate (0.4 mol/kg). The renderer gives every liquid water's refractive index and has no complex index n + ik in the visible, so the mercury is drawn opaque but not silver: its mirror-like surface, which turns back about three quarters of the light, is what is missing. Mercury here has no vapour, and liquids mix ideally (it is not to be poured into water).
